liubai.configuration.title: Liubai Settings
liubai.configuration.list.hint: Separate entries with commas. Changes are saved when done.
liubai.configuration.general.tooltip: Master switch, target frame rate, and adaptive controller settings.
liubai.configuration.general.enabled.too: When disabled, every render hook follows the vanilla path.
liubai.configuration.general.targetFps.t: Frame rate targeted by the adaptive frame budget controller.
liubai.configuration.general.adaptiveMod: Gradually increases optimization pressure while frame time remains over budget and recovers smoothly afterward.
liubai.configuration.culling.tooltip: Controls entity, block entity, occlusion, and screen-space culling.
liubai.configuration.culling.entities.to: Allows Liubai to skip ordinary entities that satisfy all safety checks.
liubai.configuration.culling.blockEntiti: Allows Liubai to skip ordinary block entities that are stably occluded.
liubai.configuration.culling.occlusion.t: Stops rendering only after repeated complete occlusion by full solid blocks. Unknown results always render.
liubai.configuration.culling.occlusionMo: AUTO stops Liubai's duplicate DDA checks when Entity Culling is detected and uses the built-in backend otherwise.
liubai.configuration.culling.safeDistanc: Screen-size and density reduction stay disabled within this distance; reliable full-solid-wall occlusion can still apply.
liubai.configuration.culling.occlusionMi: Regular occlusion checks start at this distance. Safe Distance protects screen-size and density policies only, so reliably wall-hidden objects can still be checked.
liubai.configuration.culling.checksPerFr: Maximum world visibility checks per frame. High values can increase client-thread work.
liubai.configuration.culling.budgetMicro: Caps built-in visibility work on the client thread while still prioritizing risky rechecks during movement.
liubai.configuration.culling.occludedCon: Number of consecutive occluded results required before rendering may stop.
liubai.configuration.culling.cacheTtlFra: Maximum frames a stable occlusion result is retained before another check.
liubai.configuration.culling.minimumProj: Under pressure, low-priority objects smaller than this pixel radius may be skipped. Set to 0 to disable.
liubai.configuration.lod.tooltip: Controls screen-space quality and render update frequency for objects that remain visible. Game logic ticks are never stopped.
liubai.configuration.lod.screenSpace.too: Stably skips only tiny low-priority projected entities under pressure; it never replaces block or entity models.
liubai.configuration.lod.temporal.toolti: Allows explicitly adapted renderers or visuals to update distant render state less often without changing entity or machine logic.
liubai.configuration.lod.maxTemporalInte: Maximum number of frames between render-state updates for explicitly adapted objects under critical pressure.
liubai.configuration.lod.denseVanillaEnt: Applies a stable render cap only to excess distant vanilla items and experience orbs in each chunk; game logic is unchanged.
liubai.configuration.lod.denseEntityDist: Only vanilla items and experience orbs beyond this distance enter the density budget.
liubai.configuration.lod.denseEntityHigh: Maximum distant items and experience orbs rendered per chunk under high pressure.
liubai.configuration.lod.denseEntityCrit: Maximum distant items and experience orbs rendered per chunk under critical pressure.
liubai.configuration.effects.tooltip: Controls degradation of distant shadows, name tags, and particles.
liubai.configuration.effects.reduceEntit: Disables shadows for non-critical entities beyond the configured distance.
liubai.configuration.effects.shadowDista: Maximum shadow distance at normal pressure; automatically reduced under load.
liubai.configuration.effects.reduceNameT: Hides distant non-critical name tags. Players and crosshair targets are protected.
liubai.configuration.effects.nameTagDist: Maximum distance for ordinary entity name tags.
liubai.configuration.effects.reduceParti: Reduces new particles outside the safe distance while under pressure.
liubai.configuration.effects.particleDis: Particles within this distance of the camera are never reduced by Liubai.
liubai.configuration.effects.particleSof: Distant particle admission becomes stricter after the live particle count exceeds this value.
liubai.configuration.effects.particleHig: Maximum distant new particles admitted per render frame under high pressure.
liubai.configuration.effects.particleCri: Maximum distant new particles admitted per render frame under critical pressure.
liubai.configuration.flywheel.tooltip: Controls adaptive update limiting for bundled Flywheel visuals in explicitly verified Create Fly versions.
liubai.configuration.flywheel.adaptiveLi: Strengthens Create Fly's own distance update limiter under load. It only reduces distant visual update frequency and never stops machine logic. Active only on explicitly verified versions.
liubai.configuration.flywheel.highMultip: Multiplies Create Fly's existing distant visual update interval under high pressure.
liubai.configuration.flywheel.criticalMu: Multiplies Create Fly's existing distant visual update interval under critical pressure; the final interval is capped at 31 frames.
liubai.configuration.compatibility.toolt: Protects objects with special render bounds and disables culling by mod namespace.
liubai.configuration.compatibility.entit: These entity types always render. Entries use the namespace:path format.
liubai.configuration.compatibility.block: These block entity types always render, suitable for beams, portals, and effects extending beyond one block.
liubai.configuration.compatibility.disab: Liubai does not cull entities or block entities from these namespaces.
liubai.configuration.debug.tooltip: Controls Liubai performance statistics and debug displays.
liubai.configuration.debug.showHud.toolt: Shows frame time, pressure, culling counts, and visibility-cache status in the top-left corner.
